name: ping-forbidden-synthetic
image: none: written by hand, never sent to a server
synthetic: SYNTHETIC. https://docs.influxdata.com/influxdb3/enterprise/admin/tokens/resource/create/, section "Create a system token", note "Database tokens can't call /ping or /health": a database token with the read action (db:DATABASE_NAME:read) gets an HTTP 403 from /ping and /health on InfluxDB 3 Enterprise. The doc names the status only, so the body is empty; the pinned Core image has no database token and cannot answer this (finding F8).
